@release-it/conventional-changelog.header:
# Changelog

All notable changes to this project will be documented in this file.

before:git:release: git checkout -b release/v${version} 2>/dev/null || git checkout release/v${version}
echo '✓ Switched to release branch: release/v${version}'
after:git:release:
gh pr create --title 'chore: release v${version}' --body 'Release version ${version}

## Changes
See CHANGELOG.md for details.

## Checklist
- [x] Version bumped
- [x] CHANGELOG updated
- [x] Tests passed' --base main --head release/v${version}
